description: Capture UI context, fix a visual issue, and verify via comparison recapture

recommendedCallSequence.purpose: Capture the current visual state of the target element
Edit the source file identified by the highest-confidence existing source hint
Re-capture the same element after the fix and compare against the previous capture

safetyNotes: Never output redacted values. If a value appears as [REDACTED] or [TOKEN_REDACTED], treat it as sensitive.
Do not modify files outside the project scope (node_modules, .git, system files).
Always pass reload:true and cacheBust:true to recapture_context after local file edits.
The packetPath from capture_context must be saved and passed as previousPacketPath to recapture_context.
Use profile:'debug' for initial capture (max info) and profile:'default' for recapture (comparison focus).
validationChecklist: comparisonSummary.boundingBoxDelta has before/after/delta for x, y, width, height
comparisonSummary.changedFields is a non-empty array if layout changed
comparisonSummary.verdict is one of: improved, changed, unchanged, regressed, unknown
No daemon-token or sessionToken appears in any output
